technical_and_design_decisions: Implement the functionality by extending the existing Fabric channel configuration API and reusing established ConfigTx, ConfigGroup, ConfigUpdate, and protobuf manipulation helpers.
Represent orderer endpoint additions and removals as modifications to the orderer organization configuration group's endpoint values, preserving unrelated configuration data.

Generate ConfigUpdate transactions from the original and modified configurations using the existing channel configuration diff and update mechanisms, leaving signature collection and submission to the caller.
Provide organization policy retrieval through a helper that works for application, orderer, and consortium organizations and returns the policies already represented in the configuration.
Expose retrieval of channel, application, and orderer capabilities using the existing Fabric configuration capabilities type and preserve unknown capability values when reading configurations.
Use explicit enable and disable helpers for the supported application, orderer, and channel capabilities rather than permitting arbitrary unsupported capability strings.
Expose application configuration retrieval as the existing config.Application representation, avoiding duplicate parsing logic in callers.
Implement application ACL updates as add and remove operations on the application group's ACL map while preserving all unaffected ACL entries.

Split the examples into focused update scenarios for orderer configuration, application configuration, organization management, MSP changes, and capabilities, with separate examples for endpoint and ACL changes where appropriate.
Follow the repository's existing Go API naming, error handling, validation, test, and documentation conventions.
assumptions: The increment is implemented in an existing Go Hyperledger Fabric channel configuration library with reusable configuration parsing and ConfigUpdate generation code.
Existing protobuf types and Fabric configuration semantics are sufficient; no changes to Fabric protobuf definitions, ordering services, or consensus implementation are required.
The existing library already supports loading a Config block or Config transaction and calculating a configuration update between original and modified configurations.
Endpoint operations target standard orderer organization configuration groups and use the repository's established representation for endpoint values.
Capability changes are limited to capabilities already supported by the Fabric version used by the repository; unsupported arbitrary capability injection is out of scope.

The specification requires library APIs, unit or integration coverage, and example updates, but does not require changes to command-line tools, network deployment scripts, or external documentation sites.
Existing examples and test fixtures can be reused and extended without creating a new Fabric network or implementing a full signature and transaction-submission workflow.
Effort includes implementation, code review preparation, local test execution, and correction of defects found during development, but excludes elapsed waiting time and external reviewer time.
One workday represents one developer day of focused software development effort.

activities.activity_description: Inspect the current channel configuration API, configuration object model, ConfigUpdate generation flow, existing organization and endpoint helpers, capability handling, fixtures, and example tests. Define the integration points and identify compatibility constraints.

Design public function signatures, validation and error behavior, endpoint semantics, organization policy and application configuration return values, capability enable/disable helpers, and ACL update behavior in accordance with existing package conventions.

activities.activity_name: Orderer endpoint add and remove functionality
activities.activity_description: Implement helpers to add and remove an orderer endpoint in an orderer organization configuration group, preserve unrelated configuration values, validate inputs, and support generation of a ConfigUpdate transaction suitable for a later signature workflow.

Implement a helper that retrieves policies for a specified organization regardless of whether it is an application, orderer, or consortium organization, including appropriate handling of missing organizations or policy groups.

Implement retrieval of channel, application, and orderer capabilities and add explicit supported-capability enable and disable operations for each scope. Ensure changes remain compatible with subsequent configuration update processing.

Implement a helper that locates and returns the existing application configuration as the package's config.Application representation, including validation and handling of absent application configuration.

activities.activity_name: Application ACL add and remove functionality
activities.activity_description: Implement APIs for adding and removing ACL entries in the application configuration group while preserving existing entries and ensuring the modified configuration can participate in further ConfigUpdate generation.

activities.activity_name: Focused example test restructuring and additions
activities.activity_description: Replace or split the large end-to-end configuration example into focused examples covering orderer configuration and policies, application values and policies, organization management including endpoints, MSP modifications, capabilities, application ACLs, and endpoint add/remove operations.

Add tests for successful and invalid endpoint operations, policy and application configuration retrieval, capability retrieval and toggles, ACL additions and removals, preservation of unrelated configuration, and ConfigUpdate generation and subsequent processing.

activities.activity_name: Documentation, API comments, and code quality updates
activities.activity_description: Add or update Go API comments, example descriptions, error documentation, and any package-level documentation required by repository quality checks and public API conventions.

activities.activity_name: Integration, regression testing, and defect correction
activities.activity_description: Run the complete existing and new test suite, verify formatting and static checks, exercise representative configuration update chains, diagnose failures, and apply final corrective changes.
